description: Import an existing backlog from another tool into PAPI as Backlog tasks, removing the "start from an empty board" wall. PAPI never connects to the source tool — YOU (the host) read the export and pass it here. Flat-file sources (csv, markdown, okf, taskmaster, github-issues, jira-csv) take a `raw` string; structured sources (linear) take a `rows` array you read via that tool's MCP. Import is one-way and idempotent: re-running the same import does NOT create duplicates. Shipped sources: csv, markdown, linear, okf, taskmaster, hamster, github-issues, jira-csv. Taskmaster (alias: hamster) accepts the raw .taskmaster/tasks.json — tagged or flat shape. GitHub Issues accepts a host-provided JSON array (or { issues: [...] }) and preserves issue ids, state, body, and html_url. Jira CSV accepts an exported CSV with a Summary column and preserves Issue key, description, status, priority, estimates, and any supplied URL. These sources are host-mediated; PAPI never calls GitHub or Jira. OKF accepts the bundle returned by project_export and is safe to preview with dry_run:true. trello/todoist/notion are reserved but not implemented yet. Does not call the Anthropic API.

dry_run.description: When true, normalise and dedup-check without writing anything. Use this to preview what would be imported. Default: false.

module.description: Module to file imported tasks under (default "Core").

project.description: Project id (UUID) or slug to import into, overriding the session project for THIS call only. Must be a project on your account — fails closed otherwise. PASS THIS WHENEVER YOU KNOW WHICH REPO THE SESSION IS IN: on a multi-project account a connection with no project bound cannot be resolved, and PAPI will stop and ask rather than guess.

raw.description: Raw export text for flat-file sources. CSV/Jira CSV: a header row + data rows; Jira CSV requires `Summary`. Markdown: a checklist or GitHub-style table. OKF: the project_export bundle with `--- FILE: concepts/tasks/... ---` sections. Taskmaster: the raw JSON of .taskmaster/tasks.json (tagged `{ "master": { "tasks": [...] } }` or flat `{ "tasks": [...] }`). GitHub Issues: a JSON array of issue objects, or `{ "issues": [...] }`, with `title` and optional `number`, `node_id`, `body`, `state`, `html_url`, `labels`, and estimate fields. YOU read the file, PAPI never does.

rows.description: Pre-read rows for structured sources. For linear: an array of issues you read via the Linear MCP, each like { identifier, title, description, state: { name }, priority (0-4), estimate, url }.

source.description: The tool the backlog came from. csv/markdown/okf/taskmaster/github-issues/jira-csv read a `raw` string; linear reads a `rows` array of issues. `hamster` is an alias for `taskmaster` (the product was renamed; the .taskmaster/tasks.json shape is unchanged). trello/todoist/notion are reserved extension points (not implemented yet).

name: backlog_import
